advisorJustification: CS3230 at the National University of Singapore covers the large majority of CS 577's core content, including dynamic programming, graph algorithms, divide-and-conquer, and an introduction to NP-completeness. The course omits explicit treatment of amortized analysis and only partially addresses greedy algorithms, but its added coverage of approximation algorithms suggests comparable rigor. Based on this topic overlap, CS3230 is a reasonable candidate for transfer credit toward CS 577, pending departmental review of the missing topic.
